\documentclass{article}

\usepackage{listings}
% Listbox-like entries: a node of obeylines text with inline listings code.
\newcommand\code[1]{\begingroup\thinspace\lstinline[breaklines,keepspaces=true,breakatwhitespace]`#1`\endgroup}
\newcommand\entry[2]{\node[draw, text width=3cm, rounded corners] {\begin{obeylines}#2\end{obeylines}};}

\begin{tikzpicture}
\entry{a}{\code{f(x)}}
\entry{b}{\code{y <- g(x = 1:3)}}
\entry{c}{\code{y <- h(y, x=x*2)}}
\entry{d}{\code{g(y)}}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{figure}
